Pursuant to the Governor's Executive Order N-29-20, Planning Commission Members will be participating via

- Commission meeting videos are live-streamed on the City’s website at www.rhe.city/agendas and available for
viewing thereafter.

- Members of the public may listen to the meeting live by calling: (1-669-900-6833) from any phone, Meeting ID:
896 5684 6738, Meeting Password: 857269. (Please note you will not have the ability to speak using the call-in
option from a phone line.)

-  Public  correspondence  may  be  emailed  to  Carol Corea, Administrative  Assistant  at
carolc@rollinghillsestatesca.gov. Emails received before 5:00 p.m. the night of the meeting will be forwarded to
the Commission for their consideration and included as part of the record.

- Members of the public may comment online using eComment on the “Meeting Agendas, Minutes & Videos”
page of the City’s website (www.rhe.city/agendas). Once the agenda is published, there will be an “eComment”
button next to the linked agenda under "Upcoming Events". Follow this link to the City’s SpeakUp page. After
you register, you may comment on any item on that particular agenda. These comments can be seen by the
public, will be considered by the Commission and become part of the record.

- Members of the public who wish to speak during this meeting, may join by visiting http://www.zoom.com/join
and enter the following credentials: Meeting ID: 896 5684 6738, Meeting Password: 857269.

- If using a tablet or phone, download the Zoom app and enter the following credentials: Meeting ID: 896 5684
6738, Meeting Password: 857269.

Members of the public who join the Zoom meeting will not have video, and may request to speak using the
following process: After joining the Zoom meeting, if you wish to speak, please select the "raise hand" option at
the lower portion of your screen. The host will send you a chat message to identify which item on the agenda you
would like to speak on and will unmute your mic at the appropriate time.

Agenda reports and other disclosable public records relating to each agenda item are available on the City's
website under Meeting Agendas, Minutes & Videos at www.rhe.city/agendas.

MINUTES
  PLANNING COMMISSION SPECIAL MEETING
  MONDAY, OCTOBER 5, 2020

A special meeting of the Planning Commission of the City of Rolling Hills Estates was called to
order by CHAIR CARMAN at 7:00 p.m. Pursuant to the Governor’s Executive Order N-29-20, this
meeting was held via teleconference.

2.  SALUTE TO THE FLAG

  CHAIR CARMAN led those assembled in the Pledge of Allegiance.

3.  ROLL CALL

  Commissioner’s Present:  Carman, Edler, Medawar, Schachter, Scott, Yoo, Zigrang

  Staff Member’s Present:  Jeannie Naughton, Planning Manager
  Kelley Thom, Associate Planner
  Carol Corea, Administrative Assistant

4.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES

A.  APPROVAL OF PLANNING COMMISSION MINUTES, AUGUST 31, 2020

COMMISSIONER SCHACHTER made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER YOO to,

  APPROVE THE PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING MINUTES OF AUGUST 31, 2020.

There being no objection, CHAIR CARMAN so ordered.

5.  AUDIENCE ITEMS

  NONE

6.  CONSENT CALENDAR

A.  Reading in full of all ordinances and resolutions presented for consideration to the Planning
  Commission will be waived and all such ordinances and resolutions will be read by title only.

7.  BUSINESS ITEMS

A.  PLANNING APPLICATION NO. PA-200265; APPLICANT: STEFANI CONIFF, STEFANI
  CONIFF DESIGN; LOCATION: 19 EMPTY SADDLE LANE; A request for a Neighborhood
  Compatibility Determination (NC-200266) to demolish the existing two-story home and
  attached garage and replace with a new two-story home with an attached garage.

Associate Planner Thom provided a presentation summarizing the staff report for Planning
Application No. PA-200265, a proposal to demolish an existing 2,771 sq. ft. house and garage and
to build a new 4,567 sq. ft. two-story ranch style home.

Associate Planner Thom stated that staff recommends that the Planning Commission approve PA-
200265 with the conditions outlined in the staff report.
 COMMISSIONER SCOTT noted that the design did not adhere to the “wedding cake” approach,
and asked if it met the height-to-setback ratio. Associate Planner Thom stated that second floor is
shifted slightly from the side and the front to provide visual relief. Associate Planner confirmed that
there is no “wedding cake” rule, but that the design met a similar intent of providing articulation.
Associate Planner Thom stated that the project met the height-to-setback rule.

COMMISSIONER YOO asked if any comments were received from the neighbors. Associate
Planner Thom stated that no comments were received.

COMMISSIONER SCOTT asked if there was any support from the neighbors. Associate Planner
Thom stated that aside from the standard contact with the neighbors, no written comments were
received.

Mrs. Richards, 19 Empty Saddle Lane, stated that she has contacted the neighbors and have
worked with one of their neighbors to mitigate concerns with windows on the north side of the
property.

COMMISSIONER SCOTT asked if the neighboring home with an orchard is one story. Mrs.
Richards confirmed that it is one story.

COMMISSIONER SCOTT made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER MEDAWAR to,

  APPROVE PLANNING APPLICATION NO. PA-200265 AS PRESENTED.

Ayes:  Carman, Edler, Medawar, Schachter, Scott, Yoo, Zigrang
Noes:
Absent:
Abstain:

Planning Manager Naughton stated that the Planning Commission has approved Planning
Application No. PA-200265. There is a 20-day appeal period for this item where any member of
the public may appeal the decision to the City Council. The appeal period will expire on Monday,
October 26, 2020.

B.  PLANNING APPLICATION NO. PA-200267; APPLICANT: MATT SCHNEIDER,
  ARCHITECT; LOCATION: 39 CLUB VIEW LANE; A request for a Neighborhood
  Compatibility Determination (NC-200268) for one and two-story additions to be constructed
  along the front, side and rear yards of a two-story residence. A Minor Deviation (MD-
  200269) is required to decrease the front yard area by less than 10% and for the
  encroachment of the proposed covered porch into the required front yard which does not
  project closer to the property line than the forwardmost building line.

Associate Planner Thom provided a presentation summarizing the staff report for Planning
Application No. PA-200267, a proposal for one and two-story additions to a two-story residence.
There is an existing second story deck which will be enclosed as part of the project.

Associate Planning Thom stated that staff recommends that the Planning Commission approve
PA-200267 with the conditions outlined in the staff report.

COMMISSIONER SCOTT stated that the City Council was strong in their opposition of metal
standing seam roofs and asked about its use in this design. Associate Planner Thom stated that in
this design it is being used as a minor feature and does not overwhelm the design. Standing seam
roofs have been used over bay windows and accessory buildings. Planning Manager Naughton
stated that since this home is close to the Residences at Rolling Hills Country Club, which
 predominantly have standing seam roofs as an architectural feature, staff felt that it was in line
withthe surrounding neighborhood.

COMMISSIONER SCOTT made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER MEDAWAR to,

  APPROVE PLANNING APPLICATION NO. PA-200267 AS PRESENTED.

Ayes:  Carman, Edler, Medawar, Schachter, Scott, Yoo, Zigrang
Noes:
Absent:
Abstain:

Planning Manager Naughton stated that the Planning Commission has approved Planning
Application No. PA-200267. There is a 20-day appeal period for this item where any member of
the public may appeal the decision to the City Council. The appeal period will expire on Monday,
October 26, 2020.

8.  PUBLIC HEARINGS

NONE

9.  COMMISSION ITEMS

COMMISSIONER SCOTT requested an update on the Lantana project. Planning Manager
Naughton stated that the city’s Code Compliance Officer continues to monitor the site and make
sure that it is secure. Associate Planner Thom stated that she has been in contact with the contractor
and the county’s Plan Check Engineer. Currently, the architect is waiting on details from the engineer
to prepare plans to resubmit for plan check.

COMMISSIONER SCHACHTER asked about 2 Silver Saddle. Planning Manager Naughton stated
that the work has stopped and they are in the process of preparing plans in order to obtain permits
for the unpermitted work. Permits were issued for some interior work.

COMMISSIONER MEDAWAR asked about when the CalWater project will be finished. Planning
Manager Naughton stated that they are almost done but she has not been called to do a final on the
pump station, however, it is in operation. The project has not been released but it is close.

COMMISSIONER MEDAWAR asked about a mobile structure that is next to the pump station.
Planning Manager Naughton stated that it is a generator.

CHAIR CARMAN asked about the landscaping that was supposed to screen the structure. Planning
Manager Naughton stated that it will take some time for the landscaping to grow to a height that will
screen the structure.

COMMISSIONER ZIGRANG asked if there is a city ordinance for which a project approved by the
Planning Commission has an expiration date. Associate Planner Thom stated that the Lantana
project is actively in plan check and they are eligible for another six-month extension. Planning
Manager Naughton stated that there is an expiration on planning approvals that could be from six
month to two years, depending on the entitlements. The project must be a full submittal for plan
check.

COMMISSIONER SCOTT asked when the Lantana project was approved by the Planning
Commission. Associate Planner Thom stated that the plans were approved on October 1, 2018.
   COMMISSIONER SCOTT requested that a report on the Lantana project be prepared for the next
  Planning Commission meeting. The report to include: 1) initial submission date, 2) when the
  application was deemed complete, 3) when Planning Commission heard the case, 4) when Planning
  Commission approved the project, 5) when it was submitted to Building & Safety, and 6) the
  reason(s) for the delays.

  10.  PLANNING MANAGER ITEMS

  PLANNING MANAGER NAUGHTON stated that the kick-off meeting with the consultants will be
  held on October 7th, to begin work on the Sustainability Element. This grant was applied for in 2016
  and it is just being executed, however, it aligns well with the Land Use Element and the General
  Plan Update and will be aligned with the Climate Adaptation planning work that the South Bay Cities
  Council of Governments has prepared for all of the member cities, as well as the Climate Action
  Plan.

  11.  MATTERS OF INFORMATION

  A.  CITY COUNCIL ACTION ITEMS, SEPTEMBER 8, 2020

  B.  CITY COUNCIL ACTION ITEMS, SEPTEMBER 22, 2020

  COMMITTEE MEMBER SCOTT made a motion,

  APPROVE ITEMS 11-A AND 11-B

  There being no objection, CHAIR CARMAN so ordered.

  10.  ADJOURNMENT

  CHAIR CARMAN adjourned the meeting in memory of Jerry Gliksman who passed away last
  weekend, a fellow Dapplegray HOA President and active resident who gave a lot to the community.
  The meeting was adjourned at 7:35 p.m. The next Planning Commission meeting will be held on
  Monday, November 2, 2020 at 7:00 pm via Video Teleconference.

  Submitted by,  Approved by,

  Carol Corea, Administrative Assistant  Bridget Carman, Chair

PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING
